status: review-only report; production consumes src/services/externalFactors2026Data.js read-only

shrinkage.note: derivedAdjustment2026 = observed * n/(n+K), capped; small samples collapse toward 0. Team venue effects are shrunk toward the league baseline with K=8.

teamVenueEffects.note: Effect = actual margin minus pre-game expectation (market margin preferred, else valid pre-game Fourth Down margin); positive = beats expectation. Neutral-site games excluded. Venue effects are net of priced-in travel/rest/weather.
